intent: Write JUnit 5 + AssertJ tests (reactor-test StepVerifier for Mono/Flux, Mockito for collaborators, no external services, no Thread.sleep) for IngressPacketRequest. Assert ONLY against the ast_hints method table; at least one given/when/then case per table method and per branch. Unit contract: Context Telemetry Ingestion & Validation interface-layer DTO: ONE JSON document describing one Ingress Packet {deviceId, sourceKind, samples:[{metric, tDeviceEpochMillis, value}]} (a single object, not an array and not a stream). Declares Jakarta Validation constraints (@NotBlank, @NotEmpty, @NotNull, @Valid on nested elements); the constraints are ACTIVATED by @Valid on the request parameter of IngestionController. Application ports never see this type. Cover constraint violations with a jakarta Validator (blank deviceId, empty samples, null value) and the toDomain mapping including unknown metric/source rejection.

methods.signature: IngressPacketRequest(String deviceId, String sourceKind, List<SampleRequest> samples)
methods.semantics: Plain transport record; constraints declared as Jakarta Validation annotations.

Maps to the domain: every sample gets ValidationStatus.UNVALIDATED and the given tIngress; an unknown sourceKind or metric name throws IllegalArgumentException; tDevice = Instant.ofEpochMilli(tDeviceEpochMillis).

methods.signature: SampleRequest(String metric, Long tDeviceEpochMillis, Double value)
methods.semantics: Nested record IngressPacketRequest.SampleRequest; @NotBlank metric, @NotNull tDeviceEpochMillis, @NotNull value
